summary: R1 Sales Return State Machine testing completed. Backend lifecycle (draft → pending_approval → approved → inspecting → inspected → [refund_settled | credit_settled | nego_settled | rejected]) fully functional with all 4 outcomes working correctly. Frontend list view, detail view, and status pills verified. Critical validations passed: approve does NOT create CN/adjust stock, settle DOES create CN/adjust stock (except nego), idempotency works, GL integration present.
passed_tests: Backend: Auth & Login (admin@kainnusantara.id)
Backend: List Returns (GET /api/sales-returns)
Backend: Auth Permissions (401 without token)
Backend: Create Return Draft (POST /api/sales-returns with submit_now=false)
Backend: Submit Return (POST /api/sales-returns/{id}/submit → pending_approval)
Backend: Approve Return (POST /api/sales-returns/{id}/approve → approved, NO credit_note_number, NO stock_adjusted)
Backend: Start Inspection (POST /api/sales-returns/{id}/inspect/start → inspecting)
Backend: Complete Inspection (POST /api/sales-returns/{id}/inspect/complete → inspected, inspection data saved)
Backend: Settle Refund (POST /api/sales-returns/{id}/settle outcome=refund → refund_settled, credit_note_number SET, stock_adjusted TRUE)
Backend: Idempotency (calling settle twice returns same credit_note_number)
Backend: Credit Note GL (journal_entry_id present in Credit Note)
Backend: State Guards (invalid transitions return 400)
Backend: Store Credit Outcome (outcome=store_credit → credit_settled, store_credit_amount > 0)
Backend: Nego Outcome (outcome=nego → nego_settled, credit_note_number SET, stock_adjusted FALSE - no stock movement)
Backend: Reject Outcome (POST /api/sales-returns/{id}/reject → rejected, outcome=reject)
Frontend: Navigation to Sales Returns (Penjualan → Pesanan → Retur & Barang Sisa tab)
Frontend: List View (data-testid=sales-returns-view present)
Frontend: Stats Cards (Total Return, Menunggu, Diproses, Selesai)
Frontend: Status Filter Pills (all, draft, pending_approval, approved, inspecting, inspected, refund_settled, credit_settled, nego_settled, rejected)
Frontend: Returns Table (16 return rows displayed)
Frontend: Detail View (data-testid=return-detail-view, return number displayed)
Frontend: Back Button (data-testid=return-back-btn)
Frontend: Filter Functionality (clicking filter pill activates it)

success_percentage.backend: 94% (16/17 tests passed - 1 test skipped due to test data limitation: partial settle needs order with 2+ items)
